name: AWR Segment Statistics 热点对象定位
description: AWR Segment Statistics 显示按物理读/逻辑读/行锁等待/ITL 等待/Buffer Busy Waits 排序的热点对象。通过定位热点表/索引可以针对性优化。常见问题包括热点表全表扫描、索引争用、ITL 不足、以及 Right-Growing 索引的 Buffer Busy Waits。

skip_when.desc: OLAP 大查询正常大量物理读

root_causes.name: 热点表全表扫描
root_causes.desc: 大表频繁全表扫描，Physical Reads 高。缺少合适索引或索引未被使用。

root_causes.name: 索引热点（Right-Growing Index）
root_causes.desc: 自增序列的索引叶块集中在最右端，大量并发 INSERT 导致 Buffer Busy Waits。

root_causes.name: ITL 不足
root_causes.desc: INITRANS 太小，大量并发修改同一块导致 ITL Wait。

root_causes.name: Row Lock 争用
root_causes.desc: 热点行频繁被并发修改，Row Lock Waits 高。

root_causes.name: LOB 段 I/O 密集
root_causes.desc: 频繁访问 out-of-line LOB 数据导致大量随机 I/O。

oltp.desc: 关注 Row Lock 和 Buffer Busy

step1_top_segments_physical_reads.desc: 按物理读排序的热点段
step1_top_segments_physical_reads.sql: SELECT owner, object_name, subobject_name, object_type, ROUND(value) physical_reads FROM dba_hist_seg_stat_obj obj JOIN dba_hist_seg_stat ss ON obj.obj# = ss.obj# AND obj.dataobj# = ss.dataobj# JOIN dba_hist_snapshot sn ON ss.snap_id = sn.snap_id WHERE ss.physical_reads_delta > 0 AND sn.begin_interval_time > SYSDATE - INTERVAL '1' HOUR ORDER BY ss.physical_reads_delta DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY

step2_top_segments_buffer_busy.desc: 按 Buffer Busy Waits 排序
step2_top_segments_buffer_busy.sql: SELECT owner, object_name, object_type, buffer_busy_waits_delta FROM dba_hist_seg_stat ss JOIN dba_hist_seg_stat_obj obj ON ss.obj# = obj.obj# JOIN dba_hist_snapshot sn ON ss.snap_id = sn.snap_id WHERE buffer_busy_waits_delta > 0 AND sn.begin_interval_time > SYSDATE - INTERVAL '1' HOUR ORDER BY buffer_busy_waits_delta DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY

step3_top_segments_row_lock.desc: 按 Row Lock Waits 排序
step3_top_segments_row_lock.sql: SELECT owner, object_name, object_type, row_lock_waits_delta FROM dba_hist_seg_stat ss JOIN dba_hist_seg_stat_obj obj ON ss.obj# = obj.obj# JOIN dba_hist_snapshot sn ON ss.snap_id = sn.snap_id WHERE row_lock_waits_delta > 0 AND sn.begin_interval_time > SYSDATE - INTERVAL '1' HOUR ORDER BY row_lock_waits_delta DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY

step4_check_segment_details.sql: SELECT owner, segment_name, segment_type, tablespace_name, ROUND(bytes/1024/1024/1024, 2) size_gb, ini_trans, pct_free FROM dba_segments s JOIN dba_tables t ON s.owner = t.owner AND s.segment_name = t.table_name WHERE s.owner = '&owner' AND s.segment_name = '&segment_name'
